tickets.text: The trigger waits for a pullback into structure_shift_ref / pvp_vah before buying. My test is the new high after a normal reaction (C5): W dist_to_20bar_high_pct 0.72, it is at its high now. Waiting for the lower entry usually means missing the move.

close_above:pivot_high can fire with SJM still under its high: D 0.6% under the last swing high but 2.2% under its 20-day high. A close over that pivot is a Natural Rally inside the reaction, not the new high that ends it (C5, C19).

The trigger waits for a pullback into structure_shift_ref / pvp_vah, 7.4% below. W, D and H1 HH/HL with D 7.4% above the last swing high is an Upward Trend at its high; buying the pullback instead is what C5 forbids.

The trigger waits for a corrective wave into structure_shift_ref / pvp_vah, with D 21.6% above the last swing high. A leader at its high is strength that justifies the position (C5, C16); waiting for a lower entry is the error.

h1_close_above:bar_high buys COR inside its reaction: D dist_to_20bar_high_pct 5.0 and W 5.0% under its 20-wk high, the prior Pivotal Point not cleared (C19). D close_vs_swing_high_pct 0.09 is a step over a swing, not the new high; this buys the pullback (C5).

reclaim:structure_shift_ref buys a dip to the broken pivot, i.e. buys the pullback, which C5 forbids. W and D HH/HL is a trend, but the entry must be the new high after the reaction, not the reclaim of an old level.
